Private compatibility adapter for the four bigint-buffer conversion functions used by the Solana SDK dependencies. Replaces the vulnerable native converter (GHSA-3gc7-fjrx-p6mg), rather than suppressing its advisory or relying on a native build failing. No native code or install hooks. Rejects negative/oversized numbers, invalid widths and buffers over 4096 bytes. Values used by token layouts are 8–32 bytes. Tests cover endian conversion, edge values, invalid inputs and integration with token layouts. This local module is not an upstream release or independent security audit.
